question: How many views will the top Netflix release receive in 2026 Christmas week?

calls.reasoning: Reference class: the top title in each Netflix Christmas week (2023 34M, 2024 68M with Squid Game 2, 2025 34.5M with Stranger Things 5). Narnia was delayed to 2027, so the main contender for Dec 21-27, 2026 is Fincher/Pitt's Cliff Booth: Netflix debut Wed Dec 23 (5 days in the week) after a 2-week IMAX run. Comparable post-theatrical debuts (Wake Up Dead Man 20.2M and Frankenstein ~29M, each in 3 days), scaled for 5 days plus the holiday lift, imply roughly 30-40M. Emily in Paris S6 (Dec 24) and Ray Gunn (in its week 2) look like 10-25M. Markets: Polymarket lists only this week's top-movie markets; Kalshi runs weekly Netflix view-count markets, but none was found for Christmas week, so there is no anchor. Tails: a breakout above 70M, or a date slip that leaves a weak week below 15M.

- Event window: Netflix reporting week Mon Dec 21 - Sun Dec 27, 2026 (contains Dec 25); Top 10 published ~Tue Dec 29. As of Nov 15, 2026, 0% elapsed. Resolves off the Netflix Top 10 (tudum/top10) max global views across all four lists, not hours and not Nielsen minutes.
- Narnia: The Magician's Nephew (Gerwig), originally due on Netflix Dec 25, 2026, is DELAYED: theatrical Feb 12, 2027, Netflix Apr 2, 2027 (Wikipedia; whats-on-netflix).
- The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth (Fincher dir., Tarantino script, Brad Pitt): IMAX two-week run from Nov 25, Netflix Dec 23, 2026 (Wednesday, so 5 days in the week) (IndieWire, Deadline Nov 2026).
- Emily in Paris S6 (final season): Dec 24, 2026 (4 days in the week). S5 drew 13.3M in its second week, Christmas week 2025 (Variety/Tudum).
- Ray Gunn (Brad Bird animated, Sam Rockwell/Scarlett Johansson): Dec 18, so in its first full week. Other December titles: Tantara (Korean, Dec 11), Bad Day (Cameron Diaz, Dec 11), In Waves (animated, Dec 11), Pride and Prejudice limited series (December, date unconfirmed), NFL Christmas doubleheader Dec 25 (Bills-Broncos, Packers-Bears; whether live games appear in the Top 10 with views is unverified).
- Christmas-week top titles: 2023 (Dec 25-31) Rebel Moon Part One, 34M (its week 2; it had debuted Dec 22); 2024 (Dec 23-29) Squid Game S2, ~68M in 3 days; 2025 (Dec 22-28) Stranger Things 5, 34.5M (Vol 2 released Dec 25). Netflix called Christmas Day 2025 its most-watched Christmas Day ever.
- Post-theatrical Netflix film debuts: Wake Up Dead Man (Fri Dec 12, 2025) 20.2M views / 49.2M hours in 3 days, 40% below Glass Onion; Frankenstein (Nov 2025) ~29M in 3 days (recalled, not re-verified this run).
- Markets: Polymarket has only short-dated weekly 'top movie' markets; Kalshi runs weekly Netflix top-view-count markets, but none found for Christmas week 2026.
- Searched, not found: Cliff Booth IMAX box office or tracking, Pride and Prejudice exact date, the size of any major non-English release in Christmas week.
